description: This Java class defines a configuration model for custom shipping quotes, including module code and regions, with methods to serialize its data to a JSON string.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for custom shipping quotes with JSON serialization capabilities, extending IntegrationConfiguration and implementing CustomIntegrationConfiguration and Serializable.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration data, including module code, activation status, and regions, into a JSON string.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code identifying the shipping module.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code for the shipping configuration.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Returns the list of regions associated with the shipping quotes.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the list of regions associated with the shipping quotes.
